newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian soybean prices up on demand in local market.
newsitem.headline: Indian soybean prices up on demand in local market.

text.p: Soybean prices were steady in the central Indian markets in limited activity as arrivals was poor at around 6,000 tonnes, traders said.
Soyoil prices fell by 300 rupees per tonne on heavy selling from processing plants and refineries. Business volume was dull and the undertone was easy.
Soymeal prices shrunk on limited exports demand. Soymeal yellow was $270 per tonne in export. Rapeseed extraction was 4,550 rupees FOR Bedibunder and 4,500 rupees to 4,525 FOR Bhavnagar.
